content: परामर्शः .²1 Seizing, pulling; as in केशपरामर्शः. .²2 Bending or drawing (as a bow). .²2 Violence, attack, assault; याज्ञसेन्याः परामर्शः <ls>Mb.</ls> .²4 Disturbance, hindrance; तपःपरामर्शविवृद्धमन्योः <ls>Ku. 3. 71</ls>. .²5 Calling to mind, recollection. .²6 Consideration, reflection, thought. .²7 Judgment. .²8 (In logic) Deduction, ascertaining that the पक्ष or subject possesses the हेतु; व्याप्तिविशिष्टपक्षधर्मताज्ञानं परामर्शः <ls>T. S.</ls>; or व्याप्तस्य पक्षधर्मत्वधीः परामर्श उच्यते <ls>Bhāṣā P. 66</ls>. .²9 Touching, striking gently. .²10 Affection (by disease).
